value.rationale: This is a complete global qualitative classification of a natural Fourier projector’s sharp amplification as dimension increases. The coexistence of \(n^{3/2}\) growth and infinitely many exact equality steps, together with two explicit quadratic sequences and an exact counting density, is a structural harmonic-analysis boundary not explained by the known asymptotic formula. No implication for other degrees or p-norms is claimed.
